title: Outpainting with ImagePadForOutpaint
hook: Add canvas beyond the edge. Read what the pad node makes, why its feather can switch itself off, and how much of your picture gets repainted.

verified.claim: The lab's expand_image gives the same mask as the real node at three settings, largest difference 0.
New pixels are 0.5. Feathering applies only if feathering x 2 is below both sides of the picture, and only next to padded sides.
The node's side inputs step by 8, with default feathering 40.
d_outpaint_mask ran on a CPU here, and d_outpaint validates.

unchecked: We ran no render for this lesson. The advice on how far to pad in one go, and on what a prompt should say, is common practice and untested here.
Our graph's inpainting checkpoint name is a placeholder: use yours.
